scoring_justification: The frequency response is recomputed from the agent's submitted CSV against an independent implementation of the quasi-static cascade model; pointwise comparison ensures correct reproduction of the filter response.

outputs.description: Frequency response (insertion loss and return loss) of the bandpass filter computed via the quasi-static cascade ABCD/S-matrix model.

output_contract.notes: The CSV must contain rows for frequencies from 8e9 to 18e9 Hz in 10 MHz steps (inclusive). The hidden reference CSV is generated from the same quasi-static model with the provided prototype parameters; close agreement is expected.
